test_get_dataset_backfill_plan: test the function that creates a DatasetBackfillPlan from a processing graph, dataset name, and revision
test_put_cache: test the function that inserts a cache response entry with step, dataset, revision, config, split, and optional error code
test_compute_all: test the function that runs a dataset backfill plan to completion by processing all CreateJobs tasks
test_process_all_jobs: test the function that dequeues and processes all pending jobs until the queue is empty
test_get_rows_content: test the function that fetches up to N rows from a HuggingFace Dataset and returns RowsContent with truncation info
